description: The reserved-name catalog applies to BOTH slash-invocable kinds. The demo-antigravity-reserved corpus has a workflow named `tasks` and a skill named `goal`, each shadowing an `agy` built-in slash command. Under the antigravity lens both classify (workflow + skill) and `core/name-reserved` flags both via self scope: two nodes, two warn issues. Proves the catalog covers the `workflow` kind, not only `skill`.
